description: This file implements the Timer class, which manages a timer thread, including starting, canceling, and handling timer events with callback functions. It uses POSIX threads, condition variables, and mutexes for synchronization, and integrates with GStreamer logging macros.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class that manages a timer thread, allowing arming, canceling, and executing callback functions upon timer expiry.

methods.name: timerThreadFunction
methods.description: Static function that runs in the timer thread, invoking the instance method 'timerThread'.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes synchronization primitives and starts the timer thread.

methods.name: ~Timer
methods.description: Destructor that signals the thread to quit and cleans up synchronization primitives.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels any active timer, preventing the callback from being called.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms the timer for a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread, waiting for messages or timeout to trigger callback.

methods.name: postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue, with optional urgency.
